subject: [RFC PATCH 03/57] mm/collapse: add collapse.h for the shared collapse state

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch adds a new header file mm/collapse.h to store shared state between the collapse engine and khugepaged.c. It includes an enum scan_result and struct collapse_control, which define various states and control structures for page scanning and allocation. The patch moves these definitions from khugepaged.c to the new header file, with no functional changes intended. This is a preparatory step for building the new collapse engine in its own file.

reviews.author: Lorenzo (ARM)
reviews.summary: Reviewer noted that introducing a new file requires updating MAINTAINERS, specifically the THP section, and requested this change be included in the same patch.
reviews.raw_body:
Any change that introduces a new file should in the same change update
MAINTAINERS (in the THP section to which this belongs :)

reviews.author: David (Arm)
reviews.summary: Reviewer suggested renaming mm/khugepaged.c to mm/collapse.c and moving additional code into the newly created collapse.h file, aiming to reduce churn in future changes.
reviews.raw_body:
BTW, I'm wondering whether it would result in less churn (independent of the
other changes) to

a) Rename mm/khugeapged.c to mm/collapse.c

b) Move stuff into mm/collapse.h that a new ...

David
